selection: One predeclared null hypothesis, frozen before any target access; no ranking, optimization, development selection or held-out substitution. Train/development are diagnostic strata only.

context_policy: Reuse the three frozen HANDVALIDATE-016 overlap/adjacent/space mechanical probes as controls, not additional accepted action inventory or learned words.
negative_policy: Wrong angle and partial-edge requests are rejected as out-of-contract model proposals; this is not active physical edge sensitivity.
